scope: Available ground truth and IMU within ground-truth time bounds in the 27 benchmark source sequences; not restricted to valid VIO output or matched evaluation intervals. Dataset input intensity, not demonstrated device operating limits. Full IMU peak also retained separately.

sequences.speed_method: norm of provided ground-truth velocity
sequences.gyro_method: Euclidean norm of raw gyroscope samples, radians converted to degrees; no bias correction or smoothing
sequences.angular_speed_scope: IMU samples within the ground-truth start/end timestamps
